annotations.title: But prooue.
annotations.text: <mn>◦</mn> Though vve may not extinguiſh the ſpirit, nor contemne the prophets, yet vve muſt bevvare vve be not deceiued by geuing to light credite to euery one that vaunteth him ſelf of the ſpirit, as Arch-heretikes euer did. vve muſt trie them by the doctrine of the Apoſtles & the Spirit of the Catholike Church, vvhich cannot beguile vs.

notes.text: Not raſhly to credite euery ſpirit.
